intent: Increased sensor size to 0.016 m for better line detection, added a central front sensor at y=0.06 m to improve forward sensing, and widened wheel track to 0.14 m to enhance stability and reduce oscillations. Expect improved line following robustness and fewer line loss events, especially on challenging tracks like the s-bend.
rationale: Integration feedback suggests that increasing sensor size to 0.016 m will improve line detection and reduce line loss events, which is critical given the off-track event in the s-bend trial. Adding a sensor near the center front at y=0.06 m should enhance forward line sensing, helping the controller anticipate line curvature earlier. Increasing the wheel track to 0.14 m is expected to improve stability and reduce oscillations, as wider tracks generally provide better balance. These changes are based on typical control challenges and compensations needed for this sensor layout and robot size, as well as the observed race data where the robot completed the oval track well but went off track on the s-bend. I expect these geometry changes to reduce line loss events, improve stability, and increase progress on challenging tracks. I request measurements of completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, max_error, and steering_oscillation to better understand the impact of these geometry changes on line following performance and control smoothness.
